data.name: Virtual Tour of Downtown Santa Barbara
data.headline: Get swept away to beautiful downtown Santa Barbara from the comfort of your home
data.description:
##About
Spend some time with us getting to know downtown Santa Barbara from the comfort of your home. We will walk you thrugh some beautiful and fun spots in Santa Barbara,  tell you about some of the cool history, architecture and culture of Santa Barbara, CA through the years. The experience is about 1-1.5 hours.

Live Q&A included.
data.cancellation_notes:
No refunds.
To reschedule, it must be no less then 24 hours to reschedule for another date and time in order to not incur additional fees.
data.booking_notes:
##Additional Information
Get comfy, grab some snacks, sip on a drink and get ready for a fun Santa Barbara Experience from the comfort of your home. We will send a zoom link the morning of your experience.
